```{r functemi}
#From emi

#' Internal function to order factor
#' 
#' The factor is ordered by count, otherwise ordered by the `order` variable.
#' @param .data The count data 
#' @param .var The variable to order 
#' @param order Either NA (unordered) or character vector (ordered)
order_factor <- function(.data, .var, order) {
  if(any(is.na(order))) {
    .data %>% 
      mutate({{ .var }} := fct_reorder({{ .var }}, n))
  } else {
    .data %>% 
      mutate({{ .var }} := factor({{ .var }}, levels = order))
  }
}

#' Plot barplot
#' 
#' Marginal distribution of a categorical variable.
#' 
#' @param .data The data
#' @param .var The variable to count
#' @param order Unordered (NA) or ordered factor (character vector), or "var" uses vars levels
#' @param filter_na Logical value to indicate whether to remove NA
#' @param title The title of the plot
#' @param subtitle The subtitle of the plot
plot_barplot <- function(.data, 
                         .var, 
                         order = NA,
                         filter_na = TRUE,
                         title = "", 
                         subtitle = "",
                         drop=FALSE) {
  
  if(filter_na) {
    .data <- .data %>% 
      filter(!is.na({{ .var }}))
  }
  
   if(all(!is.na(order)) && all(order=="vars")) {order <- {{.data}} |> select({{.var}}) |> lapply(levels) |> unlist()}
  
  .data <- .data %>% 
    count({{ .var }}, .drop=drop) %>% 
    order_factor({{ .var }}, order)
  
  ggplot(.data, aes(n/sum(n), {{ .var }})) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), nudge_x = 0.01, hjust = 0) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = drop) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                       limits = c(0, max(.data$n) / sum(.data$n) + 0.05)) +
    labs(x = "", 
         y = "", 
         title = str_wrap(title, 55),
         subtitle = str_wrap(subtitle, 55))
}


plot_tileplot <- function(.data, .var1, .var2,
                          order1 = NA,
                          order2 = NA,
                          title = "",
                          subtitle = "",
                          fill_title = "",
                          x_title = "",
                          y_title = "") {
  .data <- .data %>% 
    group_by({{ .var1 }}, {{ .var2 }}) %>% 
    count() 
  .data <- order_factor(.data, {{ .var1 }}, order1)
  .data <- order_factor(.data, {{ .var2 }}, order2)

  .data <- .data %>% 
    group_by({{ .var2 }}) %>% 
    mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    complete({{ .var1 }}, {{ .var2 }}, fill = list(percentage = 0)) 
  
  .data %>% 
    ggplot(aes({{ .var1 }}, {{ .var2 }}, fill = percentage)) +
      geom_tile(color = "black") +
      geom_text(aes(label = n)) +
      colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_sequential() +
      labs(x = x_title, y = y_title,
           fill = fill_title,
           title = str_wrap(title, 55),
           subtitle = str_wrap(subtitle, 55))
}

plot_upset <- function(.data, .var, title = "", subtitle = "",widlab=20) {
  g <- .data %>% 
    mutate(intersect = factor(lengths({{.var}}))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = {{.var}}, fill = intersect)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  ggupset::scale_x_upset(order_by = "degree")
  
  max_count <- max(layer_data(g, 1)$count)
  
  g + 
  geom_text(stat = 'count', 
            aes(label = after_stat(count)),
            vjust = -0.5)  +
    labs(x = "", title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    colorspace::scale_fill_discrete_qualitative()  +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = NULL, lim = c(0, max_count + 10), name = "") +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
    

}

myhtalbplot.f <- function(DATA, var,title="",subtitle="",drop=F, na.out=TRUE) {
 data <- {{DATA}} 
 if(na.out) {
    data <- data |> 
      filter(!is.na({{ var }}))
  }
  data |>
   ggplot( aes(y = reorder({{var}},{{var}},function(x) length(x)), 
                   x = prop.table(stat(count)), 
                   label = stat(count))) +
     geom_bar(position = "dodge") + 
     geom_text(stat = 'count',
               hjust = -1, 
               size = 3) + 
     scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
     scale_y_discrete(drop=drop)+
labs(x = "", 
         y = "", 
         title = str_wrap(title, 55),
         subtitle = str_wrap(subtitle, 55))

} 

pinlab <- function(x) gsub('.+-(.+)', '\\1',Hmisc::label(survdata)[paste({{x}})])

  font.size = 10,

  table.layout = "autofit",
  border.color = "gray",
  padding.top = 2, padding.bottom = 2,
  padding.left = 2, padding.right = 2,
  theme_fun="theme_zebra")
```

### Analytic skills self-rating, together

```{r analytic_skills_together}
palplot <- survdata |> select(responseid,q6_1:q6_4) |> 
  reshape2::melt(id.vars="responseid", measure.vars=2:5 ) |> 
  mutate(variable= pinlab(variable ))  |> mutate(value= factor(value, levels=c("None", "Some", "Good", "Very good", "Excellent", "Prefer not to answer"))) |> 
  group_by(variable, value) %>%
  summarise(cnt = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = round(cnt/sum(cnt), 2),total=sum(cnt))
palplot |> 
  ggplot(aes(fill=value,y=variable, x= perc)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",width=.85, stat="identity") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev,labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 40)) + 
 theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank()) + #, panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA))+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
   scale_fill_discrete(guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, byrow=T), drop=F)+
   geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(perc, accuracy = .1)), position = position_stack(vjust = .5),size=2)+
  labs(title="Analytic skills self-rating", subtitle=paste("n=",unique(palplot$total)))



```
\pagebreak

```{r datatytab}
FitFlextableToPage <- function(ft, pgwidth = 6){
 ft_out <- ft %>% autofit()
  ft_out <- width(ft_out, width = dim(ft_out)$widths*pgwidth /(flextable_dim(ft_out)$widths))
  return(ft_out)
}
 
if(params$rendering=="pdf") {
  table(hdata$data.type.curr.used_10_text,hdata$data.type.curr.used_10, exclude=NULL) |>
    kable(booktabs=T, format="html") |> kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), latex_options = c("striped","condensed")) |> 
  column_spec(1,width="10cm") 
  }

}
```

### Digital health assets together

```{r digital_health_assets_togetehr}
hdata |> select(responseid,data.type.curr.used_1:data.type.curr.used_10,data.type.curr.used_11,data.type.curr.used_12,data.type.curr.used_13) |> #select(!c(data.type.curr.used_10_text, data.type.curr.used_11_text)) |> 
  reshape2::melt(id.vars="responseid", measure.vars=2:14 ) |> 
  mutate(variable= pinlab(variable), value= factor(value, levels=c("Neither currently use nor want to use", "Want to use","Currently use" )))  |> 
  group_by(variable, value) %>%
  summarise(cnt = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = round(cnt/sum(cnt), 2)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(fill=value,y=variable, x=perc)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",width=.85, stat="identity") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev,labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 40)) + 
 theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA))+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
   scale_fill_discrete(guide = guide_legend(reverse = T, byrow=T))+
   geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(perc, accuracy = .1)), position = position_fill(vjust = .5),size=3)+
  labs(title=paste("Digital health assets together. n=",nrow(hdata)))



```

### Digital health assets together (No missing)

```{r digital_health_assets_togetehr_nona}
hdata |> select(responseid,data.type.curr.used_1:data.type.curr.used_10,data.type.curr.used_11,data.type.curr.used_12,data.type.curr.used_13) |> #select(!c(data.type.curr.used_10_text, data.type.curr.used_11_text)) |> 
  reshape2::melt(id.vars="responseid", measure.vars=2:14 ) |> 
  mutate(variable= pinlab(variable ),value= factor(value, levels=c("Neither currently use nor want to use", "Want to use","Currently use" )))  |> na.omit() |> 
  group_by(variable, value) %>%
  summarise(cnt = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = round(cnt/sum(cnt), 2), tot=sum(cnt,na.rm=T)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(fill=value,y=variable, x=perc)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",width=.85, stat="identity") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev,labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 40)) + 
 theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA))+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
   scale_fill_discrete(guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, byrow=T))+
   geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(perc, accuracy = .1)), position = position_fill(vjust = .5),size=3)+
  geom_text(aes(1.05,variable,  label = paste("n=",tot,sep=""), fill = NULL), size=3)+
  labs(title="Digital health assets together", subtitle = "(no missing)")
```

```{r  Computer_facilities_together}
  reshape2::melt(id.vars="responseid", measure.vars=2:6 ) |> 
  mutate(variable= pinlab(variable ), value= factor(value, levels=c("Unsure what this is", "Neither use nor want to use", "Would like to use","Currently use" )), variable = trimws(variable),
         variable=factor(variable, levels=c("Stand alone computer (additional to your primary computer)", "Network connected computer", "National High Performing Computer (HPC) facilities (e.g. NCI Gadi, Pawsey, ARDC Nectar, etc.)", "Institutional High Performing Computer (HPC) Facilities", "Commercial Cloud (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google, etc.)") )) |> 
  group_by(variable, value) %>%
  summarise(cnt = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = round(cnt/sum(cnt), 2)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(fill=value,y=variable, x=perc)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",width=.85, stat="identity") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev,labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 40)) + 
 theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA))+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
   scale_fill_discrete(guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, byrow=T),labels = ~ str_wrap(.x, width = 15))+
      geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(perc, accuracy = .1)), position = position_fill(vjust = .5),size=3)+
  labs(title="Computing facilities together", subtitle=paste("n=",nrow(compdata)))

```

```{r tabotherlanf}
fornow <- survdata |>  select(q26_1,  q26_1_text) |> rename(use=q26_1, Other=q26_1_text)
fornow1 <- survdata |>  select(q26_2,  q26_2_text) |> rename(use=q26_2, Other=q26_2_text)
fornowt <- rbind(fornow, fornow1)
rm(fornow, fornow1)
if(params$rendering=="pdf"){
t(table(fornowt))  |> kable( booktabs=T) |> 
  kable_styling(fixed_thead = T,bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"))
}
if(params$rendering=="word"){
  t(table(fornowt))|>
    as_flextable(include.row_percent = F,include.table_percent=F, include.column_percent=F) |> 
    width(j=1:3, width=c(2,rep(1.2,2))) 
  #FitFlextableToPage()
    
}
```



### Tools and programs together

```{r  tools_and_prog_together, out.width="80%"}

compdata |> select(responseid,q24_1:q24_22) |> 
  reshape2::melt(id.vars="responseid", measure.vars=2:23 ) |> 
  mutate(variable= pinlab(variable ), value= factor(value, levels=c("Unsure what this is", "Neither want nor need to use", "Would like to use","Currently use" )), variable = trimws(variable), variable=factor(variable, levels=c("R", "Python", "Julia", "SQL & Database management", "RStudio/Posit (free version)", "Jupyter Notebooks or Hub", "VS Code", "SAS", "MatLab", "RStudio Pro (paid version)", "Power BI", "Tableau", "Excel", "Docker or containers", "GitLab", "GitHub (free)", "GitHub (paid)", "TensorFlow", "Pytorch", "Nextflow", "Snakemake", "singularity"))) |> 
  group_by(variable, value) %>%
  summarise(cnt = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = round(cnt/sum(cnt), 2)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(fill=value,y=variable, x=perc)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",width=.85, stat="identity") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev,labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 40)) + 
 theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA))+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
   scale_fill_discrete(guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, byrow=T),labels = ~ str_wrap(.x, width = 15))+
      geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(perc, accuracy = .1)), position = position_fill(vjust = .5),size=3)+
  labs(title="Tools and programs together", subtitle=paste("n=",nrow(compdata)))

```

### AI non-Ai techniques together

```{r  AI_non_AI_tech_together}

compdata |> select(responseid,q27_1:q27_19) |> 
  reshape2::melt(id.vars="responseid", measure.vars=2:20 ) |> 
  mutate(variable= pinlab(variable ), value= factor(value, levels=c("Don't know enough about it", "Neither use nor want to use", "Would like to use","Currently use" )), variable=trimws(variable), variable= factor(variable, levels=c("Regression", "Causal analysis", "Survival analysis/ time to event modelling", "Bayesian statistics", "Decision trees/ Random forests", "Machine Learning (unsupervised/supervised)", "Gradient boosted (XGBoost, LightGBM)", "Deep Learning (CNN, RNN)", "AutoML & Hyperparameter optimisation", "Model interpretability/ explainability", "Natural language processing models ", "Clustering or pattern recognition models", "Federated learning models or distributed AI frameworks", "Graph neural networks and knowledge graphs", "Network analysis", "Preserving ML", "Reinforcement Learning & Adaptive Interventions", "Low Code No Code Tools in ML ")))  |> 
  group_by(variable, value) %>%
  summarise(cnt = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = round(cnt/sum(cnt), 2)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(fill=value,y=variable, x= perc)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",width=.85, stat="identity") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev,labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 60)) + 
  theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank()) + #, panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA))+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
 scale_fill_discrete(guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, byrow=T, nrow=2),labels = ~ str_wrap(.x, width = 15))+
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(perc, accuracy = .1)), position = position_fill(vjust = .5),size=3)+
  labs(title=paste("n=", nrow(compdata)))

```

### Frequency of use All together 

```{r  freq_use_togetehr}
survdata |> select(responseid,q37_7:q37_11) |> 
  reshape2::melt(id.vars="responseid", measure.vars=2:6 ) |> 
  mutate(variable= pinlab(variable ), value=factor(value, levels=c("Don't know", "Rarely", "For specific projects only",  "Weekly", "Daily")))  |> 
  na.exclude() |> 
  group_by(variable, value) %>%
  summarise(cnt = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = round(cnt/sum(cnt), 2), tot=sum(cnt)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(fill=value,y=variable, x=perc)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",width=.85, stat="identity") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev,labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 50)) + 
  theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank()) + #, panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA))+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
  labs(title= "Of those used, how often are they used?") + 
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, byrow=T),labels = ~ str_wrap(.x, width = 20), drop=F)+
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(perc, accuracy = .1)), position = position_fill(vjust = .5),size=3)+
  geom_text(aes(1.05,variable,  label = paste("n=",tot,sep=""), fill = NULL), size=3)
  
```

```{r techdiff}

## to still use same function, as the way qualtrics exports the data and that the "choose all 
## that apply" had yes/no need to change toe yeses to the actual answer.

##to use the existing code for the upsets need to paste together as strings


chana <- survdata|> select(q40_1:q40_7)

chana <- chana |> mutate(
q40_1  = ifelse(q40_1 =="Yes", gsub("Have any of the following technical challenges limited your use of computing facilities you intended to use? \n(Please select all that apply) -", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$q40_1 ),fixed=T),NA),
q40_2  = ifelse(q40_2 =="Yes", gsub("Have any of the following technical challenges limited your use of computing facilities you intended to use? \n(Please select all that apply) -", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$q40_2 ),fixed=T),NA),
q40_3  = ifelse(q40_3 =="Yes", gsub("Have any of the following technical challenges limited your use of computing facilities you intended to use? \n(Please select all that apply) -", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$q40_3 ),fixed=T),NA),
q40_4  = ifelse(q40_4 =="Yes", gsub("Have any of the following technical challenges limited your use of computing facilities you intended to use? \n(Please select all that apply) -", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$q40_4 ),fixed=T),NA),
q40_5  = ifelse(q40_5 =="Yes", gsub("Have any of the following technical challenges limited your use of computing facilities you intended to use? \n(Please select all that apply) -", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$q40_5 ),fixed=T),NA),
q40_6  = ifelse(q40_6 =="Yes", gsub("Have any of the following technical challenges limited your use of computing facilities you intended to use? \n(Please select all that apply) -", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$q40_6 ),fixed=T),NA),
q40_7  = ifelse(q40_7 =="Yes", gsub("Have any of the following technical challenges limited your use of computing facilities you intended to use? \n(Please select all that apply) -", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$q40_7 ),fixed=T),NA),
q40_1  = gsub("(e.g., difficulties with software setup, license procurement, or renewal.)",'',q40_1,fixed=T),
q40_5= gsub("(e.g., tools not integrating well with existing systems or workflows.)", '', q40_5,fixed=T),
q40_6= gsub("(e.g., GPUs, inability to run large models due to hardware constraints.)", '', q40_6,fixed=T))

chana <- chana |> filter(quedar)

chana <- data.frame(lala=factor(t(t(apply(chana,1,paste0,collapse=";")))))

chana <- chana |>  mutate(
  lala=gsub(";NA","",lala),
  lala=gsub("NA;","",lala),
)
chana1 <- chana %>% mutate(lala = str_split(lala, ";")) %>% 
   unnest_longer(lala)  
```

## `r paste0(strsplit(Hmisc::label(survdata$comp.access.short),split ="\n\n",fixed=T)[[1]][1])`

These following answers are for those who said they `would like to use` to any of the computing facilities and tools.

```{r getreasons}


tirar <- survdata |> select(responseid, computing.facilities_1:computing.facilities_5,comp.access.short, q23_1:q23_2_text ,q43) 
   
   
tirar1 <- tirar |> select(responseid, computing.facilities_1:computing.facilities_5,q43) |> 
  reShape( base=c('computing.facilities_'), reps=5) |> filter(computing.facilities_=="Would like to use")
   
tirar2 <- varsandlabs |> select(computing.facilities_1:computing.facilities_5) |> t() |> as.data.frame() |> 
mutate(num=1:5) |>
mutate(V1=gsub("In order to conduct your research, do you currently, or would you like to, access any of the following computing facilities? Please select all that apply, additional facilities not listed here can be added in the next question. - ","",V1, fixed=T)) |> rename(seqno=num)

tirar3 <- left_join(tirar1,tirar2) |> select(V1,q43)


fornow <- survdata |> filter(q23_1=="Would like to use") |> select(q37_1,  q23_1_text) |> rename(q43=q37_1, V1=q23_1_text)
fornow1 <- survdata |> filter(q23_2=="Would like to use") |>select(q37_2,  q23_2_text)|> rename(q43=q37_2, V1=q23_2_text)
fornowt <- rbind(fornow, fornow1)
rm(fornow, fornow1)

tirar4 <- rbind(tirar3,fornowt)

foreas <- by(tirar4$q43, tirar4$V1, FUN = function(x) {
  fornow <- unique(x)
  fornow <- fornow[order(fornow)]
  paste(fornow)
}
)

#kable(t(table(tirar4)))
```

### All infrastructure gaps together.
```{r  infrastructure_gaps_together}

infrdata |> select(responseid,infrastructure.gaps_1:infrastructure.gaps_9) |> 
  reshape2::melt(id.vars="responseid", measure.vars=2:8 ) |> 
  mutate(variable= pinlab(variable ), value=factor(value,levels=c("Not at all a limiting factor", "Somewhat limiting", "Significantly limiting")))  |> 
  group_by(variable, value) %>%
  summarise(cnt = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc = round(cnt/sum(cnt), 2)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(fill=value,y=variable, x=perc)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill",width=.85, stat="identity") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev,labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 60)) + 
  theme(legend.position="bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank()) + #, panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent",colour = NA))+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)+
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, byrow=T),labels = ~ str_wrap(.x, width = 20), drop=F)+
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(perc, accuracy = .1)), position = position_fill(vjust = .5),size=3)+
  labs(title="Infrastructure gaps", subtitle=paste("n=",nrow(infrdata)))

```

```{r interopchallenu}
chana <- infrdata |> select(interop.challenges_1:interop.challenges_8) 

chana <- chana |> mutate(
interop.challenges_1  = ifelse(interop.challenges_1 =="Yes", gsub("Where do you experience the biggest interoperability challenges? (Select all that apply.) - ", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$interop.challenges_1 ),fixed=T),NA),
interop.challenges_2  = ifelse(interop.challenges_2 =="Yes", gsub("Where do you experience the biggest interoperability challenges? (Select all that apply.) - ", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$interop.challenges_2 ),fixed=T),NA),
interop.challenges_3  = ifelse(interop.challenges_3 =="Yes", gsub("Where do you experience the biggest interoperability challenges? (Select all that apply.) - ", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$interop.challenges_3 ),fixed=T),NA),
interop.challenges_4  = ifelse(interop.challenges_4 =="Yes", gsub("Where do you experience the biggest interoperability challenges? (Select all that apply.) - ", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$interop.challenges_4 ),fixed=T),NA),
interop.challenges_5  = ifelse(interop.challenges_5 =="Yes", gsub("Where do you experience the biggest interoperability challenges? (Select all that apply.) - ", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$interop.challenges_5 ),fixed=T),NA),
interop.challenges_6  = ifelse(interop.challenges_6 =="Yes", gsub("Where do you experience the biggest interoperability challenges? (Select all that apply.) - ", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$interop.challenges_6 ),fixed=T),NA),
interop.challenges_7  = ifelse(interop.challenges_7 =="Yes", gsub("Where do you experience the biggest interoperability challenges? (Select all that apply.) - ", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$interop.challenges_7 ),fixed=T),NA),
interop.challenges_8  = ifelse(interop.challenges_8 =="Yes", gsub("Where do you experience the biggest interoperability challenges? (Select all that apply.) - ", '', Hmisc::label(survdata$interop.challenges_8 ),fixed=T),NA))


chana <- data.frame(lala=factor(t(t(apply(chana,1,paste0,collapse=";")))))

chana <- chana |>  mutate(
  lala=gsub(";NA","",lala),
  lala=gsub("NA;","",lala),
  lala=gsub("NA",NA,lala),
)

   unnest_longer(lala)
```

### `r strsplit(Hmisc::label(survdata$q75), " - ",fixed=T)[[1]][2]`



```{r highest_qualification }
 survdata|> 
  plot_barplot(q75 , title=strsplit(Hmisc::label(survdata$q75), " - ",fixed=T)[[1]][1], drop=F, filter_na = F, order="vars") 
```



## `r strsplit(Hmisc::label(survdata$q76), " - ",fixed=T)[[1]][1]`

### `r strsplit(Hmisc::label(survdata$q76), " - ",fixed=T)[[1]][2]`



```{r field_highest_qual }

survdata|> mutate(newq76=as.character(q76), newq76=ifelse(is.na(newq76) & !is.na(q76_4_text), q76_4_text, newq76), newq76= ifelse(newq76 %in% c("eng", "engineering"), "Engineering",newq76)) |> 
  plot_barplot(newq76 , title=strsplit(Hmisc::label(survdata$q76), " - ",fixed=T)[[1]][1], drop=F, filter_na = F) 
```


## `r strsplit(Hmisc::label(survdata$q77), " - ",fixed=T)[[1]][1]`

### `r strsplit(Hmisc::label(survdata$q77), " - ",fixed=T)[[1]][2]`



```{r industry}

survdata|> mutate(newq77=as.character(q77), newq77=ifelse(is.na(newq77) & !is.na(q77_5_text), q77_5_text, newq77)) |> 
  plot_barplot(newq77 , title=strsplit(Hmisc::label(survdata$q77), " (",fixed=T)[[1]][1], drop=F, filter_na = F) 
```



## `r Hmisc::label(survdata$q78 )`

```{r Extrafeed}

if(params$rendering=="pdf") {
  table(survdata$q78, exclude=NULL) |>
    kable(booktabs=T, format="html") |> kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), latex_options = c("striped","condensed")) |> 
  column_spec(1,width="10cm") 
  }
if(params$rendering=="word"){
  table(survdata$q78, exclude=NULL, dnn=c("Feedback")) |>
    as_flextable(include.row_percent = F,include.table_percent=F, include.column_percent=F)
  #FitFlextableToPage()
}
```
